verdict.rationale: Blink's docs clearly support multiple concurrent shells: a two-finger tap creates a shell, swiping switches between them, and a tab bar creates and closes tabs. Pinch-to-resize applies to the current terminal, but themes and fonts are documented only as general terminal styling, not per-session settings. Missing for 10: evidence of per-session appearance profiles, evidence of separate per-session history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
